The '''Blind Woolamander''' was a [[Galactic Alliance Guard|GAG]] tactic used to spread information through a person unaware that they had been fed false data. [[Ben Skywalker]] said that what [[Hapan]] rebels were doing with [[Galney (Lady)|Lady Galney]] was the Blind [[Woolamander/Legends|Woolamander]] in reverse.<ref name="LOTF T">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>
